messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's action to match the movement shown in the motion reference video. Follow the reference movement precisely while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and facial expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's action to match the reference video. Follow the movement shown in the reference video while retaining the current person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression. Leave the scene and camera unchanged.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then begins to walk slowly forward and to the right, turning her head to look around the environment.","camera":"A static, full-body shot from a slightly elevated angle, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A grey and white patterned crop top, high-waisted green trousers, and dark open-toed sandals.","hair_color":"Bright blue.","hairstyle":"Short, straight blue hair with bangs, tied into a small low ponytail at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, dark skin, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor, industrial-looking area with cracked stone paving, scattered rocks, wooden planks, and rusty metal pipes in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The source character's arm-raising dance was replaced with a slow walking motion: she stands briefly, then walks forward and to the right while turning her head, broadly matching the reference's walking and head-turning motion. Her blue hair, patterned crop top, green trousers, sandals, and industrial scene remain consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to match the reference movement, while retaining identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, and expression, and leaving scene and camera unchanged.
uncertain: Whether the walking path and head-turn timing precisely match the reference video.
unexpected_changes: The camera framing appears slightly lower/closer in later output frames than the source, though the scene remains the same.
